source.note: Captures the Anthropic 'system' top-level field -> llm.Request.Messages[0] with Role='system' conversion. The Go inbound test feeds an inline JSON body with model 'claude-3-sonnet-20240229', max_tokens 1024, system 'You are a helpful assistant.', and one user message 'Hello!'. It asserts the resulting llm.Request has TWO messages: [0]={role:'system', content.Content:'You are a helpful assistant.'} and [1]={role:'user', content.Content:'Hello!'}. The outbound Go test feeds the equivalent llm.Request (system+user messages) through NewOutboundTransformer('https://api.anthropic.com','test-api-key') and asserts URL='https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', Content-Type='application/json', Anthropic-Version='2023-06-01', and that the marshaled body has Model and MaxTokens>0. selected_channel, upstream_http and client_http are null because the Go tests for this case do not exercise those stages.

inbound_http._comment: Inline JSON body from the Go inbound_test.go 'request with system message' fixture (verbatim transcription of the []byte(`{...}`) literal). The Go test sets only Headers on httpclient.Request (no URL), so url is omitted.

unified_request._comment: Expected llm.Request asserted by the Go inbound test 'request with system message': MaxTokens=1024, two messages (system then user) with the indicated string contents. Other fields (Model) copied from the same fixture.

outbound_http._comment: From outbound_test.go TestOutboundTransformer_TransformRequest case 'request with system message'. The Go test asserts method=POST, url='https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', headers Content-Type and Anthropic-Version, body unmarshals to MessageRequest with Model='claude-3-sonnet-20240229' and MaxTokens>0. The system message is re-serialized into the Anthropic top-level 'system' field by the outbound converter; the exact wire shape of system is not byte-asserted in the Go outbound unit test for this case (pending source snapshot for the precise 'system' serialization).
